deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v3.14 -> canary (10%)

jess: Quick q — which FF gates the new routing stack?

mike: it's `onboarding.new-routing`. currently OFF. planning to pin canary cohort c-42 to routing-v3

sara: +1 to ephemeral pin. suggest 10% for 15m with close watch on 502s/latency :eyes:

ops-bot: [ALERT] p90 latency +120ms at gateway (spike started 1725000008)

jess: seeing increased 502s from canary nodes `/generate`  — rollback if it keeps up

mike: unpinning cohort c-42 now -> running `deploybot rollback --cohort c-42 --route routing-v2`

deploy-bot: Rollback executed for cohort c-42 by mike at 1725000032 :white_check_mark:

sara: metrics back to baseline. p99 and error budget recovered

tim: pls add a short note to the release thread. root cause hypothesis?

jess: hypothesis: cache priming storm on new routing causing upstream 502s during warmup

mike: action: add canary warmup (5m) + throttled cache priming. also add healthcheck to canary route

sara: reattempt ramp in 30m with the extra warmup sounds good

deploy-bot: Scheduled reattempt at 1725001800 per mike

jess: release notes draft: "Deferred `onboarding.new-routing` pin after canary 502s. Added 5m warmup and cache-throttle on canary. Reattempt scheduled." 

mike: leaving this thread open for follow-up, will post postmortem if reattempt still problematic

tim: thanks team. filing follow-up ticket: RD-2392 (canary warmup + cache throttle) :memo:
